title: Quit and Keep Sessions with one idle terminal: 30 s later only that terminal's daemon, its plugin and its host run; the terminal comes back
why: R-LIFECYCLE ORPHANS: Lawrence's Mac had 380 cmux-tui processes with parent 1 from old tagged DEV apps. Fleet repro on build 3a43a131 (2026-11-04): with no terminal, Cmd-Q, SIGTERM, SIGKILL and a crash all left the app session's owner (cmux-tui --headless --session cmux-app-...), the Chief session's owner (cmux-chief-...) and each one's screen detection plugin running with parent 1; only Quit and End Sessions ended them. The owners keep nothing a person can see: their state is durable and the next launch starts them again. With live terminals and Keep Sessions the owner and its terminal hosts stay by design (pty-holder.md D1), so this journey quits with none. It expects agents off (the capture slot's default, ACPMUX_AGENT_LAUNCH=deny): a working Chief brain host keeps its Chief owner by design. The last case (R-LIFECYCLE ORPHANS part 2, acpmux): after Quit and Keep Sessions with one idle terminal, the app session's daemon and the terminal's host stay by design, but the acpmux daemon and router must not (no agent works); this case is red until the acpmux PR (r-lifecycle/orphans-acpmux) is in the build.
source: R-LIFECYCLE ORPHANS (handoff/rewrites/R-LIFECYCLE/DESIGN.md section 8), fleet repro rlc-orphans-base-3..6
